features.text: POST-SURGICAL ALIGNMENT: Maintains toe correction and joint protection following bunion surgery.
PNEUMATIC FOREFOOT PAD: Reduces swelling and discomfort during recovery.
INCLUDED BUNION SOCK: Separates the great toe for optimal alignment.
COMFORTABLE PADDED LINER: Provides cushioning and support for sensitive post-op feet.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
